description: Hong Kong-based Asian beauty and fashion retailer running its own VANA Family (VANATeam) Creator Program on its own site: creators get a unique discount code, earn commission on every sale made with it, progress through Glow/Radiance/Vibrance/Aurora tiers, receive a free Welcome Box of best-selling K-beauty products, and cash out via PayPal at a US$30 threshold.

evidence.summary: STYLEVANA's official VANA Family join page describes its own Influencer/Creator Program: applicants need an active public TikTok, Instagram or YouTube account; creators receive a unique discount code and earn commission on every sale made with it across four tiers (Glow, Radiance, Vibrance, Aurora), each displaying a 5% commission rate on returning-customer orders; commissions are redeemed monthly via PayPal once earnings reach US$30, and new creators can claim a free Welcome Box of K-beauty products. The program's own Terms & Conditions state the exact commission percentage is not fixed: it is dynamic, set by creator tier and by new-vs-returning order type, and shown in the creator dashboard.

The official program FAQ answers the earnings-limit question directly: 'Is there a maximum amount I can earn? No, there is no maximum limit on how much you can earn through our Creator Program... allowing for limitless potential!' — an explicit no-cap statement on the brand's own page, so commission_cap is recorded as uncapped. Separately, the US$100/month maximum on the page applies only to creator-referral bonuses (US$10 per referred creator), not to sales commission. No absolute creator counts are published, so creator_saturation stays unknown.

Third-party figures for Stylevana's separate network affiliate listings conflict with each other and with the creator program's dynamic structure: Lasso lists a Stylevana (US) affiliate program at 10% with a 60-day cookie, LinkApprove reports about 2.7% on a 30-day cookie, and Shopper lists up to 5%. Because the brand's own terms state the creator-program rate is not fixed and directory figures conflict, commission_rate is recorded as null.
